theorems.name: Submission.smr_restriction_isCurrent
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Integrable (fun x => v x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x)) μ) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ (x : Eucl P) (α : Covector (Eucl P) k), |v x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ∀ A : Set (Eucl P), ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn U k, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, S ω = ∫ x in A, v x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x) ∂μ
